name: derivation
description: What a Space can find out about cognition it built on something else, and what byte destruction may and may not take with it. LIST DEPENDENTS walks provenance in the derived direction so a revised root's downstream artifacts can be reviewed instead of guessed at (Spec §57.5, §63.5); reachability is topology, not a verdict. PURGE PAYLOAD destroys Evidence bytes while the record, its digest, its citations and its provenance role survive (§60.6) — the data-minimization instrument, which is a different promise from element purge.

cases.name: one hop of provenance runs inputs to outputs, and names the Activity it came through
DEPTH is what turns one hop into the closure
the closure pages like every other LIST
reachability is topology, not a verdict: the listed artifact is untouched
a transformation that recorded no Activity lineage is not discoverable
an unknown root is answered exactly as an absent one
DEPTH 0 asks for the element itself, which is not one of its dependents
a DEPTH that is not a non-negative integer is a type error, not a bound
and neither is a word that happens to sit where a number goes
the root operand is a string, not whatever coerces to one
a payload purge is confirmed with the exact literal, or it is not a purge
only Evidence has a payload to purge
and the refusal erased nothing on the way to refusing
a payload purge destroys the bytes
the payload reports that it was purged, rather than reporting nothing
the record survives with its digest, class and observation time
and so does the citation that pointed at it
purging an already-purged payload is a no-op, not an error
